cd /app && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json,subprocess,sys,time,random
def run(req):
    data=json.dumps(req).encode()
    t=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","/app/submission/main.py"],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=90)
    dt=time.time()-t
    return p,dt

random.seed(1)
n=12000
# big ring SCC, all non-done, plus 16 strong actions each enabled on a random subset via exit edges to a done sink
done_state=n  # we'll make n+1 states, last done
states=[]
for i in range(n):
    states.append({"delivered":[[]]})   # P=1,R=1,D=1 non-done
states.append({"delivered":[[[1]]]})    # done (len==R)
edges=[]
seen=set()
def add(s,a,t):
    if (s,a,t) in seen: return
    seen.add((s,a,t)); edges.append([s,a,t])
for i in range(n):
    add(i,"x",(i+1)%n)
# strong actions
fair=[{"action":f"s{k}","mode":"strong"} for k in range(16)]
for k in range(16):
    # enabled at states ~ every 16
    for i in range(k,n,16):
        add(i,f"s{k}",done_state)
# some internal edges for s0 so not all removed? keep none internal
req={"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":states,"edges":edges,"start":0,"fairness":fair}
p,dt=run(req)
print("rc",p.returncode,"time",round(dt,3),"out",p.stdout[:120],p.stderr[:200])
PYEOF
